title: Update Corp Card manual selection
summary: Corporate card matching and liability management capabilities are added to expense management, enabling manual selection of corporate cards for expenses with new pages, queries, and automated posting workflows.
key_points: New expense source enumeration and corporate card expense matching interface introduced
Added corporate card liability transfer page and selection management codeunit
New queries for posted and pending report card displays and transactions
Expense and expense report tables extended with corporate card reference fields
Updated posting orchestration and validation to handle corporate card expenses with enhanced test coverage
